message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"A newer technology designed by ASU Professor Greg Asner has been used in Hawaii to detect colour/tone changes to the seafloor"}],"reasoning":"Users (marine scientists, conservation) and rationale are identified and referenced via footnotes. However, mission goals, objectives and requirements are not stated quantitatively (no orbit, sensor, resolution or coverage requirements), and the 'what it will do' is vague. Some claims are loosely supported (e.g. 'Oceans 30% more acidic' is an overstatement of pH change). Adequate rather than accomplished."},{"id":"C2","level":"Accomplished","mark":8,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Final design and simulation should be completed by the end of week 9."}],"reasoning":"A Gantt chart with dependencies, deadlines and status is given, with task descriptions and information sources. Contingency is implicit via 'ongoing' and cutting strategies, but not explicit. Plan is reasonably robust and tied to the mission narrative, though information sources are only a list of links and the link to mission is thin."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii"}],"reasoning":"Progress is mostly reading and tutorials. No orbit, launch or coverage calculations or STK simulation results are presented, so there is no technical content demonstrating design progress. Minor work completed only."},{"id":"C4","level":"Adequate","mark":14,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic since the industrial revolution"},{"where":"Useful Links","quote":"https://wwf.panda.org/our_work/our_focus/oceans_practice/coasts/coral_reefs/"}],"reasoning":"Clear headings and logical sections with footnotes. Some inconsistencies: Gantt figure referenced 'on the next page' with a caption-less image, bullet task list is informal, footnote numbering is in text but Useful Links are not tied to in-text citations, and 'Coral reefs' section is awkward. Writing is generally readable with minor grammar issues ('nurture'). Adequate overall."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"partial","where":"Mission Concept & Rationale"},{"id":"R2","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R3","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"},{"id":"R5","met":"partial","where":"Useful Links"},{"id":"R6","met":"partial","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"'Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic' misstates the pH change (about 30% increase in hydrogen ion concentration); needs precise wording."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"Bleaching is attributed to acidification, whereas the main driver is thermal stress; the causal chain is inaccurate."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","issue":"No space-segment design content (orbit altitude, inclination, launch vehicle) is applied despite R2; no software selection (R3) is stated."}],"overall":"Good motivation and a clear Gantt plan, but the report lacks space-segment technical content, explicit software choice, and quantified mission requirements. Some scientific statements are inaccurate. Preliminary progress is mainly reading and tutorials, so it is below the level needed for full marks."}
